remarks: Elegant and impeccably appointed, this exceptional top-shelf residence offers refined living in the heart of the village's historic district. You will find this Architectural Gem has been masterfully reimagined for modern living while honoring its rich provenance. Rob Sanders Architects, renowned for historic restorations transformed this residence into a timeless, sophisticated masterpiece showcasing perfectly scaled living spaces. Inside, exquisite craftsmanship is evident throughout-from custom cabinetry and millwork to bespoke lighting and curated finishes. Wide-plank chestnut floors, and authentic 6-over-6 windows provide warmth and character, blending historic charm with elevated, modern comfort.Highlights include an exceptional Chef's KIT that has every high-end detail imaginable, stunning Sunroom, handsome Library w/wet bar, fabulous Scullery, beautiful Living & Dining Rms, luxurious Primary Suite w/Spa inspired Bath, comfortable Home Office. Set on 1.95 picturesque acres of lush lawns, mature gardens, expansive patios and classic stone walls, the property also includes a classic New England barn and enjoys a premier in-town location with easy access to the village center with wonderful restaurants, cafes, gourmet market and wonderful array of shops. Close proximity to train, schools, and parks as well as Downtown New Canaan and Ridgefield..Approx 1 Hour to NYC. Sophistication at every turn. Impossible to Reproduce!
